'''swccgpc''' is the [[Players Committee]]'s channel on the live-streaming service Twitch, at [https://www.twitch.tv/swccgpc twitch.tv/swccgpc]. The channel first streamed on 16 March 2013.<ref name="twm">[https://www.twitchmetrics.net/c/41372974-swccgpc SWCCGPC – Streamer Profile & Stats], TwitchMetrics (read 15 October 2026): "SWCCGPC started streaming on Twitch on Mar 16, 2013".</ref> It carries live coverage of Players Committee tournaments and the weekly show [[Holotheatre]]; recordings are uploaded afterwards to the PC's [[Star Wars CCG (YouTube channel)|Star Wars CCG YouTube channel]], where Holotheatre uploads carry the note "Broadcasted live on Twitch -- Watch live at https://www.twitch.tv/swccgpc".<ref name="ht-first">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iF2uYNHjGSk SWCCG Holotheatre: MPC HYPE!! Interview with MPC crew + more], Star Wars CCG (29 March 2019).</ref>

== Organization ==

The Players Committee's 2024 organization chart lists Twitch among the social media platforms run by the Marketing Advocate's team, whose duties include streaming and commentating in-person and online events. The Streaming sub-team was led by [[Dan Tartaglione]] (Stream Team Lead, Holotheatre host) and had about 20 members, among them [[Joe Olson]]; [[Chris Gogolen]] handled store support and streaming, and [[Brandon Baity]] was the streaming audio/visual technician.<ref name="org2024">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Star Wars CCG Players Committee Organization Chart], starwarsccg.org (PDF, dated 6 May 2024).</ref>

== Streams ==

The channel streams the Players Committee's major events, including the World Championship, US Nationals and state championships. In August 2026 it carried the [[2026 U.S. National Championship]] on 1 and 2 August (about 10 and 8 hours) and the 2026 Minnesota States final on 26 August.<ref name="twm" /> Twitch keeps past broadcasts for a limited time, so the lasting archive of these streams is the YouTube channel.

* Holotheatre: 204 episodes on YouTube, 2019 – 2026. See [[Holotheatre]].
* Tournament streams: see [[Star Wars CCG (YouTube channel)]].
